# Unpivot code columns safely by quoting identifiers and filtering null/blank values, then count and join to lookup.
cols = ["11","15","20","23","33","35","45","56","59","67","73","80","84","91","92"]
selects = []
for c in cols:
    # Quote identifier to avoid numeric-to-int parsing and cast to VARCHAR
    selects.append(f"SELECT CAST(\"{c}\" AS VARCHAR) AS address_type_code FROM student_address_wide WHERE \"{c}\" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAST(\"{c}\" AS VARCHAR)) <> ''")
union_all = " UNION ALL ".join(selects)

sql = f'''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH all_codes AS (
    {union_all}
), counts AS (
    SELECT address_type_code, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM all_codes
    GROUP BY address_type_code
)
SELECT c.address_type_code, l.address_type_description
FROM counts c
LEFT JOIN address_type_lookup l
  ON l.address_type_code = c.address_type_code
ORDER BY c.cnt DESC, c.address_type_code ASC
LIMIT 1
'''
